resources.string: LinkDeck Companion lets LinkDeck on your laptop show notifications in real time, reply to messages, and show battery and charging status. It talks to LinkDeck only through adb (USB, Wi-Fi, or Bluetooth) and never uses the internet.
Notification access: OFF. LinkDeck turns it on automatically when it installs this app. You can also turn it on yourself below.
Only LinkDeck through adb can read notifications. Other apps can only read the battery status, which Android already shares with every app.
